geometry_policy: Metadata-only join. No GLB, GeoJSON geometry, feature IDs, centroids, coordinates, heights, or colors are changed.
matching_policy: Exact OSM feature ID only. No proximity-based guesses.
limitations: Names, addresses, and material tags are only present where source data provides them.
An exact OSM ID match does not guarantee that a field such as address or facade material is populated.
This index does not contain facade photographs or inferred photographic materials.
Buildings without exact OSM IDs are intentionally left unguessed; further spatial matching must be reviewed and confidence-labelled.

Part 1 and Part 3 inventory properties could not be retrieved through the GitHub file endpoint during this run; their original source properties remain accessible through their existing inventory files and the shared index.
